data.name: Galawezh
data.gender_notes: Galawezh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'galwa', meaning 'to be gentle'. This name is often given to boys who are expected to exhibit tender and delicate traits in their character. The name Galawezh carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate, Tender” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Galawezh usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate, tender and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes compassion and gentleness towards others.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Galawezh total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
